verdict.rationale: ROS 2 covers only the data-collection front of this loop. It can record and play rosbags, offers a Python API to read and write bags from your own code, and community users credit its data bagging, so collected data could be pulled into a training pipeline with custom code. Nothing in the evidence shows integration with model training or deploying updated models back to a fleet. Missing for 10: training-pipeline integration, a model packaging and versioning workflow, fleet-wide model deployment/OTA rollout, and any independent corroboration of an end-to-end data-to-model loop.
